$comment: replicatio R-MCP roster. LOCAL/stdio ONLY by design (no confidential data egress). The single source of truth for the full P0-P3 connector contract (incl. opt-in remote rmcp + opportunistic academic MCPs) is ./CONNECTORS.md. JSON cannot carry comments, so per-server notes live there. r-mcptools is P0 (mandatory). rstudio-r is P1 (recommended): it needs ${RSTUDIO_MCP_PATH} pointing at a built clone of github.com/lerlerchan/rstudio-mcp-server; if that env var is unset this server may fail to start, which is tolerated - the plugin still loads (graceful degrade). NEVER place a hosted/HTTP server here.
